projects.title: ME-AIQ / Evidence-Based Engineering Research
projects.summary: Local synthetic numerical experiments compare expected outcomes with CPU and CUDA results, preserving both correctness checks and performance limits.
projects.boundary: In the recorded host-specific comparisons, CUDA was correct but did not beat the best CPU result. Synthetic calculations do not establish physical material behavior, general engineering correctness or a production AI service.
